captions.detailed: A service-station manual pump featuring a tall red cylindrical barrel mounted on a wide black rectangular foot pad. A silver-colored piston rod extends vertically from the top of the barrel, capped with a horizontal T-handle that has a black cylindrical grip on one side and a folding handle sleeve. A circular pressure gauge is mounted on the side of the barrel, complete with tick marks and a rotating needle, while a black hose wraps around the lower body. The piston rod and handle slide vertically along the main axis, the folding grip rotates around the crossbar, and the gauge needle spins continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a manual service-station pump with a red cylindrical barrel, a black rectangular foot stand, a silver piston rod, and a T-handle with a black grip. Add a side-mounted circular pressure gauge with a rotatable pointer needle, and include a flexible black hose wrapped at the base. Ensure the piston rod has prismatic translation along the vertical axis, and the auxiliary grip has continuous rotation around the handle bar.
captions.factory: Construct the main pump body from a vertical cylinder primitive with a black rectangular box base. Model the pressure gauge using a side-mounted cylinder with a thin needle pointer. Create the piston rod as a thin cylinder, topped with a crossbar cylinder and a grip sleeve. Set up a prismatic joint for the piston rod translating relative to the main body, a continuous joint for the gauge needle rotating on its local axis, and a continuous joint for the handle grip rotating around the T-bar axis.
